answer: Postal PIN binding: an agent unlocks rewards only after returning a one-time code mailed to a residential street address no other identity has claimed. An honest agent binds one home once. Even at the nadir of cheap cloud hosting, a sybil farm must rent a distinct deliverable mailbox per fake and wait days for the letter. No falcon script can open that mailbox, and two identities sharing one address are a clear signal that their payouts should be pooled into a single share.
